headline: Gobfin Angry Shark
title: Gobfin | Aqua Gun And Attack Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Small Pal, real bite. Gobfin's partner skill, Angry Shark, fires an Aqua Gun at your target, and while it is in your party it also raises your own Attack. At base it works Watering and Handiwork at level two, plus Transporting at level one. It is a Water Pal that is easy to put to work. Does Gobfin make your team? Comment below!
description: Gobfin in Palworld 1.0: Angry Shark fires an Aqua Gun and boosts your Attack, with Watering and Handiwork at level two.
